stereo.note: Two synchronized global-shutter cameras on one USB 2 Type-C module, 52 mm apart. Calibrate and compute depth on the Mac mini; no factory calibration file or onboard depth processor has been verified. Confirm delivered color/mono specification before buying.

usb.note: Three cameras plus Pico fit four direct ports, but provisional 500mA per camera leaves zero margin. Include externally powered hub. Target 2A output, including 1.5A camera allocation plus 0.5A hub/cable margin; actual current unpublished and must be measured. A hub adds no USB2 bandwidth; test simultaneous MJPEG capture at modest frame rate. Main Pi buck retains 6A qualification.

hub.name: Raspberry Pi USB 3 Hub
hub.note: Three-camera version only. Four USB-A ports, captive 80 mm upstream lead, external 5 V USB-C input. Official ideal-diode isolation prevents upstream backfeeding. Strap mounting uses approximate published body dimensions; check the received unit.

cameraPower.name: DFRobot 2-Way USB Fast Charge Buck Module
cameraPower.note: Three-camera version only. Separate 6–32 V input USB-A buck source, default 5 V, up to 3 A listed.
